name: FUSB302B USB-C Power Delivery
description: The `fusb302b` component supports the onsemi [FUSB302B](https://www.onsemi.com/products/interfaces/usb-type-c/fusb302b) USB Type-C and Power Delivery (PD) controller. It acts as a PD sink: when a USB-C power source is attached, it negotiates a power contract for a fixed supply voltage of up to 20 V.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the FUSB302B. Defaults to `0x22`, the address of the FUSB302BMPX. The FUSB302B01MPX, FUSB302B10MPX and FUSB302B11MPX use `0x23`, `0x24` and `0x25`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) the FUSB302B is connected to. Required when more than one I²C bus is configured.

config_entries.label: Interrupt Pin
config_entries.description: The GPIO pin connected to the `INT_N` output of the FUSB302B. `INT_N` is an open-drain output; the internal pull-up of the pin is enabled by default.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Request Voltage
config_entries.description: The voltage in volts to request from the source, from `5` to `20`. See [Power Negotiation](https://esphome.io/components/fusb302b/#power-negotiation).

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.
